description.value:
Duration constant

Your Strikes against your Marked quarry deal 1 additional die of the weapon's damage type. This increases to 2 additional dice at 14th level and 3 additional dice at 18th level.

cinderfall.incomplete: Otherwise a clean, real pattern — DamageDice with a level-gated diceNumber formula exactly like Precision's "ternary(lt(@actor.level,11),1,ternary(lt(@actor.level,19),2,3))" (P4) — entirely blocked on the missing Mark predicate. The Waywarden's central subsystem, The Mark (classes.waywarden.json flags.cinderfall.terms[0]: "designate a creature as your quarry, gaining a growing bonus to track, target, and punish it specifically"), has zero Foundry-schema footprint anywhere in the corpus. classes.waywarden.json:65 itself carries "rules": []. No card anywhere grants a TokenMark effect (site/data/cards/abilities/, class-features/, feat-effects/ are all empty scaffold directories -- confirmed via ls, contents are .gitkeep only). Real pf2e's own equivalent mechanic (Ranger's Hunt Prey) is fully buildable and precedented, but that infrastructure (an action item + a TokenMark-carrying effect item) does not exist for Waywarden and is not one of the 56 files in scope for this draft. This card is blocked until a future pass authors the base Mark action/effect.
